items.title: What Is Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) Telling Investors With Its First WAIHA Approval?
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson (NYSE: JNJ) received FDA approval for IMAAVY (nipocalimab-aahu) as the first treatment for warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia (wAIHA). The approval introduces the first therapy specifically shown to be safe and effective for this rare and sometimes life-threatening blood disorder.
